summary: Bad-price-action selectivity screen vs the canon book residual losers, with adversarial verify

result.summary: PA/bars family screen on 713 trades (275 canon), 2025-quantile thresholds, both tails, all window/pattern slices. Two genuine bad-PA markers on canon residual losers: (1) wicky_10 <= 0.4664 (2025-q20) - LOW wick dominance, i.e. full-bodied directional bars into the entry level - canon WR gap -13.9pp/-15.6pp (2025/2026), universe -14.0pp/-7.7pp, sign-stable across a q10-q30 sweep, flagged 48 canon trades carrying only $3.0k of the $47.1k book; (2) indec_30 > 0.3667 (2025-q75) - canon -15.6pp/-10.0pp, universe same-sign but <10pp (PLAUSIBLE tier), flagged 41 canon trades are dead money ($562). Their union is the best composite: canon -21pp/-15pp, universe -12.1pp/-8.8pp, though cutting it forgoes +$4.5k of 2026 profit (big flagged winners), so WR edge > expectancy edge. Inverse good-PA marker: netpath_30 >= q90 (+12-14pp everywhere, +$15.4k on 39 canon trades). netpath_60 low tail passes on WR but flagged trades net +$13.2k - not actionable. A-pattern is NOT immune: wick_low crushes A (universe 7% vs 41% WR pooled, both years directionally), the opposite of A's chop immunity - but cells are under-n. Key negative results: lvl_churn_30 (the prioritized churned-level hypothesis) is affirmatively rejected - canon WR rises with churn while the universe is flat, a canon-only artifact; vwap_cross_30, vwap_slope_30, bbw_state, rng_30, and the netpath_30 low-tail whipsaw hypothesis are all dead. The PA flags do NOT explain the Jul-Sep 2025 -$91 stretch (flagged P&L there is positive); they trim residual losers broadly across the year instead.
nulls: lvl_churn_30 (hard-tested per task): hypothesis 'churned level = bad' is REJECTED, not just null. Canon WR rises monotonically with churn both years (0-1 crossings: 38%/41%; 6+: 52%/58%) but the full universe is flat-to-opposite (0-1: 31%/30%; 6+: 27%/25%; best split gaps -0.2pp/-1.0pp) -> canon-only artifact, fails corroboration in both directions. No tail (q20-q90, either sign) passes the full rule in any slice.
vwap_cross_30: dead. Best same-sign canon split min|gap| = 3.3pp (all-slice, q20-q80 both tails). No pass in any window/pattern slice.
vwap_slope_30 (flat vwap = balance): null. Best same-sign min|gap| = 5.6pp (low tail q33: -13.2pp in 2025 but only -5.6pp in 2026); fails the 10pp-both-years bar everywhere.
bbw_state (squeeze vs expansion): completely dead - best same-sign min|gap| = 0.0pp; 2026 sign flips at every threshold tried.

netpath_30 LOW tail (the whipsaw hypothesis): null on all-slice; in the pre window canon showed the OPPOSITE (low netpath +11.4/+13.5pp better) but the universe flips sign in 2026 (-9.2pp) -> uncorroborated, discard. Only the q90 HIGH tail (good-PA) generalizes.
wicky_10 HIGH tail (wick-dominated bars = bad): null - high wicks never hurt; only the LOW tail matters.
indec_30 universe magnitude never reaches 10pp (max 6.6pp) - confirmed at canon level only.
Window interaction: neither pre nor gold produced a passer that the all-slice did not already contain (gold cells n=5-7/yr, below rule); wick_low is directionally negative in both windows both years.

Pattern interaction B vs B2: no B- or B2-specific passer survives both years + universe; per-year sub-pattern gaps for wick_low/indec_hi/np60_low flip or attenuate (e.g. np60_low B2: -29.5pp 2025, +8.4pp 2026).
send-later features not in scope; netpath_60 nulls: 2 NaN rows, bbw_state 2 NaN rows (dropped implicitly, no effect).
